newsitem.title: USA: Bard Diagnostic gets FDA bladder test okay.
newsitem.headline: Bard Diagnostic gets FDA bladder test okay.

text.p: Bard Diagnostic Sciences, a division of C.R. Bard Inc, said Tuesday it received federal regulatory clearance for its new test for bladder cancer.
The U.S. Food and Drug Administration approved the new BTA stat test that uses the same technology commonly seen in one-step pregnancy tests, Bard said in a statement.
The test can be performed in a doctor's office, providing physicians and their patients with accurate information in minutes, it said.
C.R. Bard, based in Murray Hill, N.J., is a maker of medical devices.
